message.content: "There's a Place" debuted on *Please Please Me*. (While the Carpenters song was included on the album, it was originally a Marvelettes single from 1961.)
message.reasoning_content: There's a Place (and Please Mr. Postman) both on Please Please Me. There's a Place first released on it; Postman was a cover earlier released by Marvelettes. Both appear on album though. "First released on it" — Postman originally by Marvelettes, so There's a Place.
